items.summary: Says that as Lieutenant Governor she will make higher education and college more affordable.
items.title: Make higher education more affordable

citations.quote: As Lieutenant Governor, I will make higher education more affordable, expand paid internships, and strengthen career pathways.
I’ll work to make college more affordable and ensure seniors can age with dignity.

items.summary: Says that as Lieutenant Governor she will expand paid internships and strengthen career pathways.
items.title: Expand paid internships and strengthen career pathways

citations.quote: As Lieutenant Governor, I will make higher education more affordable, expand paid internships, and strengthen career pathways.

items.summary: Authored, as a member of the State Assembly from 2006 to 2012, 60 bills that were signed into law by two governors, according to the State Treasurer's official biography.
items.title: Assembly bills signed into law, 2006-2012

citations.quote: As an Assembly Member, she authored 60 bills that were signed into law by two different governors

items.summary: Authored state legislation banning phthalates, a class of chemicals, in baby products; the Treasurer's biography says it became a model for federal legislation authored by U.S. Senator Dianne Feinstein in 2008.
items.title: Ban on phthalates in baby products

citations.quote: Her successful legislation to ban toxic chemicals in baby products, known as phthalates, became a model for federal legislation that was authored by U.S. Senator Dianne Feinstein in 2008.

items.summary: Ordered, after being selected Chairperson of the State Board of Equalization in 2016, three external audits of the agency.
items.title: External audits of the Board of Equalization

citations.quote: Upon being selected Chairperson of the Board of Equalization in 2016, she ordered three external audits of the agency

items.summary: Led, as a San Francisco Supervisor (2002-2006), an effort to create the city's Disadvantaged Business Enterprise program for small businesses taking part in public works projects.
items.title: San Francisco Disadvantaged Business Enterprise program

citations.quote: She led an effort to create the city's Disadvantaged Business Enterprise program to empower small businesses to more easily participate in public works projects.
